vehicle: TAIGA-02: roughly two-metre-long unmanned Russian planetary-exploration-inspired Mars rover. Squat cylindrical brushed-silver instrument housing with a closed flat top on a rectangular dark olive-green chassis. Four broad solid-metal wheels, two per side, with raised chevron ribs and dark hubs. Each wheel connects visibly to a sturdy short suspension arm. A short camera post sits at the FRONT edge of the circular housing with one dark lens block. One robust two-joint drilling arm mounts at the FRONT centre of the chassis, ending in a short cylindrical drill head, folded against the front for travel. Rear is a plain olive service panel. Restrained housing seams, recessed fasteners, matte green paint and enclosed dark joints. Scientific field instrument, no weaponry, cabin or ornamental antennas.

mission.name: Deep Strata Expedition
mission.purpose: Inspect exposed sedimentary layers and collect shallow drill samples.
mission.arrival: A squat descent platform delivers the rover near an eroded basin rim.
